connector.name: temporal-mcp
connector.registryDescription: Wall-clock awareness for LLM agents. Two tools: elapsed-time-between-turns + day rollover detection.
connector.summary: Hosted at temporal-mcp.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package temporal-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mirrorethic account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Pick any opaque string (UUID, passphrase, etc.) — we SHA-256 hash it for storage and never see the original. The token is your private key for your timeline. Example: 'Bearer 8c7d4b8a-...'
